title: 第十二章 赤县古道第十三章 红衣仙娥
lines: “这片海洋，是宇宙中所有亡者的魂归之地？岂不是说，神话传说中的幽冥地府，并不是不存在，而是存在于微观世界？”
惊恐和震撼之后，众人各抒己见，热烈议论。
“用科学的方式，找不到人体内的三魂七魄，或许是因为三魂七魄太过微小，以某种特殊状态存在于微观中。人死后，三魂七魄失去载体，自然回归我们眼前的微观魂海。”
“没错！人的灵魂，诞生于胎腹中。灵魂必须比胎卵更微小才行，否则何以容纳？”
有人发出疑问：“我们真的在地球的微观层面？地球就是整个宇宙生灵魂归的地府？我觉得，微观到这个地步，地球的物质状态其实已经不存在了，我们可能……已经不在地球上。”
“或者说，我们是来到了一个完全区别于宏观宇宙的特殊界面。我们可能真的回不去了！”
“回不去”三个字，太让人绝望。
意味着前途未卜，生死难料，气氛变得压抑。
海中一直都有凶魂在嘶吼，远处的深海不时响起惊雷一般的古怪叫声，让人内心难定，暗测魂海是否栖居有妖魔？
随着青铜船舰行进，又有凶魂飞蛾扑火一般欲跃上甲板，但都死无葬身之地。
守护青铜船舰的力量很强，它们攻不破。
这是唯一让人暂时心安的事！
沉闷和惊忧中，自然也有乐观派。
高欢手缠白色绑带，站在舰艏最前端，兴奋道：“我就说我们肯定是从北冰洋坠落到了冥界，现在你们信了吧？北冰洋就是古时的北海！你们说，数千里大的鲲鹏在北冰洋挪不开身，在眼前这座无边无际的魂海中，应该可以随便翻天覆地吧？”
“另外，你们知道为何人死之后，都有头七的说法？因为七天后，灵魂就再也回不去了！从地球到魂海的距离，就是七天。”
一个研三的高材生，却极其迷信，满嘴神话传说和臆测，若在以前大家肯定心中暗笑，但现在，每个人的科学信仰都崩塌，只能如他一般凭乱七八糟的猜测去解释眼前的一切。
李唯一对他们毫无根据的各种推测一点兴趣都没有，既来之则安之。修炼出超凡名堂后，他再也不像刚醒来时那么彷徨和迷茫。
人生有了追逐的目标，有了动力，有了憧憬，有了努力和前进的方向。
修炼超凡。
更进一步的超凡。
他想知道，超凡的尽头，人能强大到何等地步？是否如神话传说一般，飞天遁地，力能搬山，驱赶星辰……
就算真的来到了地府幽冥，鬼荒世界……那又如何？
他和蔡羽彤带着那两位在踩踏中受伤的老教授，准备去医棚检查和医治。
这时，青铜船舰距离海面那座石峰柱碑已经很近，相距数公里而已。
其中一位伤到腿的老教授，擦了擦眼镜，终于看清上面的四个文字符号，惊了一声：“这文字和青铜船上那些碑文完全不一样，很像甲骨文和金文，和汉字同源。”
他们两位虽不是专业的，但都是古文字爱好者，这几天一直在研究青铜船上的碑文，在尝试解译。
另一位被踩中胸口，面如土色的老教授，被李唯一搀扶着。他凝视石峰柱碑片刻，道：“比甲骨文和金文所在的时期还要早一些，文字的演变都有迹可循，应该可以解译出来。”
伤到腿的老教授道：“我觉得，跟《仓圣鸟迹书碑》上那些文字有些像，可能存在于同一时期。”
《仓圣鸟迹书碑》上一共有二十八个鸟迹文字，传说是文明之祖“仓颉”造象形文字的本形。
李唯一内心震动：“这四个刻文，跟汉字同源？岂不是说，在极其久远的过去，有古华夏的人类抵达过这里？”
“恐怕是这样……先解译出来吧，看到底刻的是哪四个字？”
两位老教授对文字的兴趣极浓，也不急着检查伤势，各自从包里掏出文字古籍、钢笔、笔记本，认真的讨论和研究。
不多时，他们得出结论。
在笔记本上写下四个字——“赤县古道”。
“赤县古道！”
围在周围的人不少，皆困惑不解。
海中的一座石峰柱碑，怎么会刻下如此莫名其妙的四个字？
青铜船舰帆布满张，快如奔马，已行到石峰柱碑下方。近距离观之，更清晰感受到峰碑宏伟大气的压迫感。
它不知屹立在这浩荡魂海中多少年月，险峻陡峭，猿鹄难渡，是那么高耸和永恒。海中，本不该有这样一座切面平整的石峰，或是某大威能者携来此处。
刻在上面的四个字，神斧天刀劈凿而出，每一笔都似大地裂痕。
伤到腿那位老教授，一边收起钢笔和棕皮笔记本，一边道：“赤县可不是你们理解的一市一县中的县！”

"This ocean is the place where the souls of all the dead in the universe return? Doesn't it mean that the underworld in myths and legends does not exist, but exists in the microscopic world?"
After being frightened and shocked, everyone expressed their opinions and discussed enthusiastically.
"Using scientific methods, we cannot find the three souls and seven souls in the human body. Perhaps it is because the three souls and seven souls are too tiny and exist in the microcosm in a special state. After death, the three souls and seven souls lose their carrier and naturally return to the microscopic soul sea in front of us."
"That's right! The human soul is born in the womb of the fetus. The soul must be smaller than the fetal egg, otherwise how can it be accommodated?"
…
Someone raised a question: "Are we really at the microscopic level of the earth? The earth is the underworld where the souls of the entire universe return? I think that at this microscopic level, the material state of the earth actually no longer exists, and we may... no longer be on the earth."
"In other words, we have come to a special interface that is completely different from the macroscopic universe. We may really not be able to go back!"
…
The three words "can't go back" are too disappointing.
It means that the future is uncertain, life and death are unpredictable, and the atmosphere becomes depressing.
There are always evil spirits roaring in the sea, and strange thunder-like cries are heard from the deep sea in the distance from time to time, making people confused. Is there a demon living in the soul sea?
As the bronze ship moved forward, there were more evil spirits trying to jump onto the deck like moths rushing to the fire, but they all died without a burial place.
The force that guards the bronze ships is so strong that they are indestructible.
This is the only thing that brings temporary peace of mind!
Amidst the depression and panic, there are naturally optimists.
Gao Huan, with his hands wrapped in white straps, stood at the front of the ship and said excitedly: "I said that we must have fallen from the Arctic Ocean to the underworld. Do you believe it now? The Arctic Ocean is the North Sea in ancient times! You said that the Kunpeng, which is thousands of miles long, cannot move out of the Arctic Ocean. In this boundless sea of souls in front of you, it should be able to turn the world upside down at will, right?"
"In addition, do you know why there is a saying that after death, the first seven days are said to occur? Because after seven days, the soul can never go back! The distance from the earth to the sea of souls is seven days."
A top student in the third year of graduate school is extremely superstitious, full of myths, legends and conjectures. In the past, everyone would have laughed secretly in their hearts, but now, everyone's scientific belief has collapsed, and they can only explain everything in front of them with random guesses like him.
Li Weiwei was not interested in their baseless speculations at all, and he would just settle for it. After cultivating extraordinary skills, he was no longer as hesitant and confused as when he first woke up.
In life, there is a goal to pursue, motivation, vision, hard work and a direction to move forward.
Cultivation is extraordinary.
A further level of transcendence.
He wanted to know, at the end of the extraordinary, how powerful can a person be? Is it like myths and legends, flying into the sky and hiding from the earth, with the power to move mountains and drive away stars...
Even if we really come to the underworld, the ghost world... so what?
He and Cai Yutong took the two old professors who were injured in the stampede and prepared to go to the medical shed for examination and treatment.
At this time, the bronze ship was very close to the stone peak pillar monument on the sea, only a few kilometers away.
One of the old professors who injured his leg wiped his glasses and finally saw the four characters on them clearly. He was startled: "This character is completely different from the inscriptions on the bronze ship. It is very similar to oracle bone inscriptions and bronze inscriptions, and has the same origin as Chinese characters."
Although the two of them are not professionals, they are both lovers of ancient writing. They have been studying the inscriptions on the bronze ship these days and trying to interpret them.
Another old professor with an earthy face who was stepped on in the chest was supported by Li Weiwei. He stared at the Shifeng Pillar Stele for a moment and said: "It is earlier than the period of Oracle Bone Inscriptions and Bronze Inscriptions. There are traces of the evolution of the writing, and it should be possible to interpret it."
The old professor who injured his leg said: "I think it is somewhat similar to the words on the Cang Sheng Bird Traces Stele, and it may have existed at the same time."
There are a total of twenty-eight bird trace characters on the "Cang Sheng Bird Trace Book Stele", which is said to be the original form of the hieroglyphics created by "Cang Jie", the ancestor of civilization.
Li Weiwei was shocked in his heart: "These four inscriptions have the same origin as the Chinese characters? Doesn't it mean that in the extremely long time ago, humans from ancient China arrived here?"
"I'm afraid that's the case... let's decipher it first. What four words are engraved on the bottom?"
The two old professors were very interested in writing and were not in a hurry to check their injuries. They each took out ancient writing books, pens, and notebooks from their bags, and discussed and studied them seriously.
After a while, they came to a conclusion.
Write four words in your notebook - "Chixian Ancient Road".
“Chixian Ancient Road!”
There were many people around, all confused.
How could a stone pillar monument in the sea be engraved with such incomprehensible four words?
The bronze ship's sails were spread out, and it was as fast as a galloping horse. It had already reached the foot of the stone pillar monument. Looking at it from a close distance, you can more clearly feel the majestic and oppressive feeling of the monument.
It has stood in this vast sea of ​​souls for countless years. It is so steep and steep that it is difficult for an ape or a swan to cross. It is so towering and eternal. There shouldn't be such a flat stone peak in the sea, or someone with great power should have brought it here.
The four words engraved on it were carved out by the divine axe and the heavenly knife, and each stroke was like a crack in the earth.
The old professor who injured his leg said while putting away his pen and brown leather notebook: "Chixian County is not a county within a city and a county as you understand it!"
